title: Two-step enrollment: register the device only after the first TOTP code
spec: Implement Activation as its doc comments say, composing invites::InviteBook (including the new get), devices::Devices, rate_limit::Limiter and crewcraft_accounts::totp_guard::TotpGuard (shown for reference; its own task is T201, so use the real guard once that lands). Replace the `todo!()`s and delete the `#[allow(clippy::todo)]` and the `#[allow(dead_code)]` on Pending. Use `Totp::with_defaults` and `Totp::verify` (skew `SKEW_STEPS`, no last_used) to check a first code against the pending secret; on success call `TotpGuard::enroll` and then `TotpGuard::verify` with the same code and time so the guard's last counter records it. The `crewcraft-accounts` and `crewcraft-totp` dependencies are already added to the crate. No other new dependencies.
